generate_images_ddpm: load a pretrained DDPMPipeline and generate images from random noise using pipe()
generate_images_ddpm_batch: generate multiple images at once by setting batch_size in the DDPMPipeline call
generate_images_ddpm_steps: control image quality by adjusting num_inference_steps in the DDPMPipeline call
generate_images_ddpm_deterministic: make DDPMPipeline generation reproducible by passing a torch Generator to the call
generate_images_ddpm_numpy: get numpy arrays instead of PIL images by setting output_type to np.array
